report: We're 2-7 and a long way back, but nobody on the roster is hurt and the lineup is clean. Stafford faces Arizona, which allows the 2nd most QB points. Jameson Williams gets New England, which allows the 2nd most WR points. White plays Thursday night, so he's the first one to lock in. Tee Higgins is hot with 28.17 PPR per game over his last three.
